purpose: Map the v88 VAB current-rule demand/friction miss into permanent regressions in the SAME Stödassistenten learning system.

mappings.product_miss: The same product had VAB runtime guidance and specialized 12-15 truth but no canonical under-12 record that permanently guards the April 2026 deadline transition, serious-illness exception and minimum route-changing age question.
mappings.fix_or_guardrail: Add one source-bound NEEDS_REVIEW record for the existing under-12 VAB path, keep the existing 12-15 record, distinguish ordinary post-April-2026 deadlines from transitional and serious-illness cases, and fail closed on professional wording. Do not create another VAB matcher or app.
mappings.truth_boundary: A user's statement that a child is sick does not establish eligibility, serious illness, amount or deadline exception. Age and date are collected only when route-changing. Material rules remain primary-source and review gated; no raw family story, identity, diagnosis or exact financial detail enters the public learning package.
